preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.
The number of roads m is between n-1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities within the valid range [1, n].
The number of provided edges matches m.
The graph formed by the cities and roads is connected.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n-1 lines, one for each city from 2 to n.
Each output integer is a valid remainder modulo 10^9+7.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[i] == min_path_number_mod(n, edges, i + 2) for i in range(n - 1))
postconditions.description: For each destination city k (where k ranges from 2 to n), the output is the remainder modulo 10^9+7 of the lexicographically smallest concatenated road number sequence from city 1 to city k.
